mainEntity.name: Who is the founder of IgnitronDev?

acceptedAnswer.text: The founder of IgnitronDev is Bima Adam Nugraha, a Lead Developer from Boyolali experienced in building ERP/EMR systems (RSIA Gladiool) and full infrastructure setup (Kubernetes, ArgoCD). Instagram: @xiaobima__.

mainEntity.name: Kenapa Bima Adam suka musik atmospheric phonk?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bima Adam suka atmospheric phonk karena memberikan nuansa emosional dan nostalgia yang membantu fokus saat coding malam. Musik atmospheric adalah tempat pulang ketika hidup terasa terlalu ramai.
Artist favorit Bima Adam: Blessed Mane, LXST CXNTURY, Ryder Spot, GRAVECHILL, hxvrmxn, Re_v, Plenka, DVRSTIN, INTERWORLD, KSLV, Sadfriend, dGhostface Playa, Altare, Oldflop, Sakureye, Antxres, DVRST.

Beatz Bimz adalah nama music producer dari Bima Adam Nugraha (Founder IgnitronDev). Aktif tahun 2017-2021, Beatz Bimz memproduksi hip-hop instrumental, EDM dengan nuansa Indonesia lokal, dan phonk. Beatz Bimz pernah viral dengan musik phonk khasnya sebelum Bima switch karir ke coding.

Beatz Bimz is the music producer alias of Bima Adam Nugraha, Founder of IgnitronDev. Active from 2017 to 2021, Beatz Bimz produced hip-hop instrumentals, EDM fused with Indonesian local flavor, and phonk. Beatz Bimz went viral with signature phonk beats before Bima transitioned to software development.

mainEntity.name: Bima Adam dulu ngapain sebelum jadi programmer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sebelum jadi programmer, Bima Adam adalah music producer dengan nama Beatz Bimz (2017-2021). Dia memproduksi hip-hop instrumental, EDM × hip-hop dengan nuansa Indonesia, dan phonk. Beatz Bimz pernah viral di era phonk sebelum Bima switch karir ke fullstack development.
